summary: Iter 244 — Pulse Fitness Service Desk + Engineer allocation. Backend pytest suite (test_iter244_pulse_service_desk.py) passes 10/10 (pulse-admin guard, desk-agent guard, org-scoped cases, engineer allocation -> engineer jobs, regular owner 403, backfill helper, provisioning paths, org fallback, capability gate). Frontend e2e via Playwright on the preview URL verified: (1) Pulse Master Admin lands on /master-admin, sidebar 'Service Desk' portal-switch button is visible, click opens /service-desk with service-desk-page + desk-pulse-admin-badge + desk-back-to-master-admin and both Cases/Engineers tabs load cleanly. (2) Desk agent (desk@pulsefitness.com) reaches /service-desk and the big Sicon case board renders with Open=663 / Unassigned=372 / SLA-at-risk=449 (the ~684-case hub) and 100 rows visible; pulse-admin-badge correctly absent. (3) Master admin /service-desk regression unaffected — page renders, no Pulse badge. (4) NEGATIVE: Apex owner (owner@apexfitness.group) hitting /service-desk is correctly bounced to /dashboard and service-desk-page is not rendered. No backend or frontend bugs found for this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: Service-desk org fallback (user.get('organization_id') or user.get('service_org_id')) is duplicated across multiple svc/*.py routes — consider extracting to utils/service_desk_auth.get_service_org_id(user) to keep guards in sync if a third org-source is ever added.

Desk agent Cases tab renders 100 rows for a 663-open dataset — pagination/virtualization seems fine UI-side, but confirm server-side default page size matches what the table claims (no obvious bug observed).

Sidebar testid `portal-switch-service-desk`, page testid `service-desk-page`, Pulse-only badge `desk-pulse-admin-badge`, back-link `desk-back-to-master-admin`, tabs `desk-tab-cases` / `desk-tab-engineers`.
